# IVX Android Emulator QA — GitHub Actions Ubuntu Runner
#
# Uses `npx expo run:android` which handles ALL the complexity:
#   - Expo prebuild (generates native Android project)
#   - Gradle build
#   - Boots an Android emulator
#   - Installs the APK
#   - Launches the app
#
# Then we capture screenshots and run Maestro flows.
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
#
# Secrets required (already configured in repo):
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

name: Android Emulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
      - 'expo/eas.json'
      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
      - 'expo/package.json'
      - 'expo/assets/images/**'
      - 'expo/plugins/**'
      - '.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_qa:
        description: 'Run full chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Android Emulator Build + QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
      apk_path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
      apk_hash: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}
      apk_size: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }}
      emulator_name: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }}
      android_version: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }}
      emulator_status: ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          npm install --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Verify Expo CLI
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          echo "=== Node version ==="
          node --version
          echo "=== Expo CLI version ==="
          npx expo --version
          echo "=== Expo package version ==="
          node -e "console.log('expo:', require('expo/package.json').version)"

      - name: Expo prebuild (generate native Android project)
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Build Android APK
        id: build
        working-directory: expo/android
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 30
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          echo "=== Building APK with Gradle ==="
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "=== Gradle exit code: $GRADLE_EXIT ==="
          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "build_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "build_status=failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "=== BUILD FAILED — last 200 lines ==="
            tail -200 gradle-build.log
            echo "### Build Failure — Last 200 Lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            tail -200 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi

      - name: Check build result
        working-directory: expo/android
        if: steps.build.outputs.build_status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          echo "::error::Gradle build failed. Creating diagnostic issue."
          {
            echo "## Android Emulator QA Build Diagnostics"
            echo ""
            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
            echo ""
            echo "### Gradle build output (last 400 lines)"
            echo '```'
            tail -400 gradle-build.log 2>/dev/null || echo "not found"
            echo '```'
          } > diagnostic-body.md
          gh label create "android-qa-diagnostic" --color "FBCA04" 2>/dev/null || true
          gh issue create \
            --title "Android QA Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" \
            --body-file diagnostic-body.md \
            --label "android-qa-diagnostic" 2>&1 || \
          gh issue create --title "Android QA Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" --body-file diagnostic-body.md 2>&1 || true
          exit 1

      - name: Find built APK
        id: apk
        working-directory: expo/android
        run: |
          echo "=== Searching for APK ==="
          APK_PATH=$(find . -name "*.apk" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::No APK found"
            find . -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null
            exit 1
          fi
          APK_PATH_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$APK_PATH")" && pwd)/$(basename "$APK_PATH")"
          echo "path=$APK_PATH_ABS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "APK found: $APK_PATH_ABS"
          ls -lh "$APK_PATH_ABS"
          # Compute SHA256 hash for verification
          APK_HASH=$(sha256sum "$APK_PATH_ABS" | awk '{print $1}')
          echo "hash=$APK_HASH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "APK SHA256: $APK_HASH"
          APK_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "size=$APK_SIZE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "APK size: $APK_SIZE bytes"

      # Upload the APK IMMEDIATELY after finding it, before emulator QA.
      # This ensures the APK artifact is available even if emulator QA fails.
      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-android-apk-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

      # ============================================================
      # Boot Android Emulator + Install + Test — ALL inside the runner
      # script block so the emulator stays alive for every step.
      # reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 ONLY keeps the emulator
      # booted during its `script` block. Moving steps outside kills adb.
      # continue-on-error ensures the APK artifact is still available
      # even if emulator QA fails.
      # ============================================================
      - name: Boot Emulator + Install APK + Launch + QA
        id: emu

- name: Expo prebuild (generates native Android project)
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Patch build.gradle — force JS bundle in debug builds
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          echo "=== Before patch ==="
          grep -n "debuggableVariants" android/app/build.gradle || echo "(not found — default is [\"debug\" which skips JS bundling)"
          # Replace the commented-out debuggableVariants line with an active one
          # This forces ALL variants (including debug) to bundle JS + assets
          sed -i 's|// debuggableVariants = \["liteDebug", "prodDebug"\]|debuggableVariants = []|' android/app/build.gradle
          echo "=== After patch ==="
          grep -n "debuggableVariants" android/app/build.gradle
          if ! grep -q 'debuggableVariants = \[\]' android/app/build.gradle; then
            echo "=== Fallback: inject after react { ==="
            sed -i '/^react {/a\    debuggableVariants = []' android/app/build.gradle
            grep -n "debuggableVariants" android/app/build.gradle
          fi

# IVX Android Emulator QA — GitHub Actions Ubuntu Runner
#
# Builds a RELEASE APK (with JS bundle + assets), then runs emulator QA.
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
#
# Secrets required (already configured in repo):
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

name: Android Emulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
      - 'expo/eas.json'
      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
      - 'expo/package.json'
      - 'expo/assets/images/**'
      - 'expo/plugins/**'
      - '.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_qa:
        description: 'Run full chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Android Emulator Build + QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:

          echo "| APK Size | \`${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }} bytes\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
